'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Oh, brother, I'd be neck-deep in work without you. I'm doing it all so the city keeps on living, mind you, that's why I do all the moves. Alright, I'll tell you about my secret affair, since it has been going so smoothly so far. I'm thinking of setting up garment manufacture, to sew and sell vests, holsters, armor. As in the best fashion houses in Europe, haha. This time I need to understand what exactly is inside the 6B43 armor, the green one, it's also heavy as shit, you probably know. I want to figure out how it breaks down, and what it's based on. Just like the last time, bring me a couple of those, one totaled, and one a bit more pristine.}}

* Hand over the [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)|6B43 assault armor]] in 0-75% durability
* Hand over the [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)|6B43 assault armor]] in 75-100% durability

In this quest you have to hand over 2 [[6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR)|6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armors]]. One with 0-75% durability and one with 75-100% durability. The armors require no inserted armor plates since the condition is measured by the integrated soft armor.

Since friendly fire is always active, you can easily complete this quest with the help of a another player through the use of a [[20x1mm toy gun|Blicky pistol]].

Another way to complete this quest solo is to let [[border snipers]] shoot you so that your character dies far outside the playable space of the map. You can insure the armor with [[Prapor]] to receive it back in roughly a day to a day and a half, but it will be quicker if you use [[Therapist]] to insure it. You may have to do this method multiple times for the same armor to get it down to the required durability.

Another option is to shoot the orange propane containers found on [[The Lab]] or [[Customs]] whilst being inside the radius. The hot gas damage will damage all parts of your armour, so be careful as this will also deal a lot of body damage and may kill you if you are not being careful. It is best not to stand directly next to the propane while it explodes, and to only use one explosion at a time. Take in extra gear and meds to swap to so that you do not fight with broken armour or low health.
